items.name: 100 Lil Jumps
items.description: Nara the frog has been cursed and can only make 100 jumps. Complete the challenge and break the curse.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.description: The 2048 puzzle game
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: 2048 Plus
items.description: A feature-packed implementation of the classic puzzle game 2048, built using the LÖVE framework.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Use the D-Pad to move tiles, L1/R1 for power-ups, B to undo, and Y to switch themes.

items.name: 6 Feet Under
items.description: Our zombie friend has risen from her grave. Help her find her way back home so she can rest easy. Game is focused on the speedrun community but if you're a casual player, this game is also good for you.
items.install_note: Ready to Run! Thanks to Stoff for making this game and generously allowing us to host it on our site.

items.name: 8-BIT BUCCANEER
items.description: A pirate-themed roguelike game, in which you sail around, buy treasure maps, dig up treasure, and fight enemy ships and monsters.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: A7Xpg
items.description: The goal of the game is to collect all the gold bullions found in each level and avoid crashing into any of the enemies. As you progress through the levels you will encounter harder enemies, and you can gain a short period of invincibility if you gather gold at high speeds.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: L'Abbaye des Morts
items.description: The plot is set in 13th century. The player takes a role of Jean Raymond – one of clerics who preached about the poverty of Christ and a life without material aspirations, and who were for this reason treated as heretics by the Catholic Church. Jean is running away from crusaders who want him dead.
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: Abe's Amazing Adventure
items.description: A scrolling, platform-jumping, key-collecting, ancient pyramid exploring game, vaguely in the style of similar games for the Commodore+4. Abe's Adventure files are already included and ready to go.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Abombniball
items.description: The objective of Abombniball is to defuse all the explosives on each level. As a ball, this would normally be a simple task, however each level is filled with traps and devious puzzles.
items.install_note: You defuse bombs by landing on the bombs square, however you can only defuse the bomb thats currently counting down. Trying to defuse any other bomb will cause it to explode.

items.name: Absolute Reflex
items.description: Absolute Reflex is a Classic Bullet Hell showdown, but you can STOP TIME at any point and TELEPORT to safety! Though if you want to try for the score, refrain yourself.
items.install_note: Download the game from https://jukio.itch.io/absolute-reflex and copy the exe file into the port folder.

items.name: Abuse
items.description: A fork of the original Abuse SDL port from http://abuse.zoy.org/. An intense 2D shooter. Plays best on dual analog stick devices. Just download and play.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Adonthell - Waste's Edge
items.description: A free 2D role-playing game in the style of classic SNES RPGs. As a loyal servant of the elven Lady Silverhair you arrive at the remote trading post of Waste's Edge, where a theft threatens to ruin your mistress' reputation. Explore the Redwyne Inn, talk to its guests and uncover the truth.
items.install_note: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.

items.name: Adventure Rush
items.description: Get ready for another incredible adventure, face spiders, monsters and goblins in a side scrolling system with Shoot 'Em Up elements and try out numerous equipment with your hero. But beware of the fearsome Dragon!!
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam or download the free demo from Itch.io and copy all game files into the assets folder.

items.name: Aerofoil
items.description: Aerofoil is a port of John Calhoun's Glider PRO, the classic paper airplane game for Apple Macintosh computers released in 1994.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Aestheta
items.description: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!
items.install_note: Install port. Purchase the game on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730600/Aestheta/) or Itch (https://aplovestudio.itch.io/aestheta). Copy all game files into the ports/aestheta/assets folder.

items.name: Afternoon Stalker
items.description: Afternoon Stalker, a robot-killing video game. It is a clone of the 1982 Night Stalker video game for the Intellivision, from Mattel Electronics.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Air
items.description: 'AIR' follows Yukito Kunisaki, a traveling puppeteer searching for a winged girl from a childhood legend, who arrives in a small seaside town. There, he meets various girls, each with their own unique stories and supernatural abilities. As Yukito unravels their pasts and the town's mysteries, he dis
items.install_note: Add your game assets to `ports/air/gamedata`.

items.name: Alchemy Quest
items.description: Alchemy Quest is a simple puzzle game where players combine alchemic elements to create exotic combinations and score points. A launcher for Open Alchemist is included.
items.install_note: All files are included and game is ready to play.

items.name: Aleph-One Marathon 1
items.description: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon 1 first person shooter.
items.install_note: All files have been included.

items.name: Aleph-One Marathon 2
items.description: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon 2 first person shooter.
items.install_note: All files have been included.

items.name: Aleph-One Marathon Infinity
items.description: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon Infinity first person shooter.
items.install_note: All files have been included.

items.name: Alex the Allegator 1
items.description: A very short Allegro-powered platform game for one or two players. Jump around the short level and try to find your dreamgirl Lola.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Alex the Allegator 2
items.description: A mouse-driven puzzle game for one or two players. Place and slide tokens on the board to clear your own color, but watch your score - you need the higher one to win.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Entirely mouse-driven - the left stick moves a cursor and A clicks. Two-player works fine on one controller since both players share the same cursor in turn.

items.name: Alex the Allegator 3: Radioactive Racers
items.description: A somewhat unfinished top-down racing game. Throttle, brake and steer around a single lap track, racing against AI opponents.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Alex the Allegator 4
items.description: A GameBoy-style Allegro platform game. Guide Alex the Allegator through 10 levels to rescue his family, with 23 bundled fan-made bonus level packs to pick from at startup.
items.install_note: Ready to run. On startup, pick the main campaign or browse a curated set of bonus community level packs.

items.name: Project Alexandria
items.description: Pilot the Prometheus craft through alien landscapes and strike back at the Zokai in this Asteroids-style physics shooter with a full soundtrack.
items.install_note: Ready to run, no additional files needed.

items.name: Alex vs Bus: The Race
items.description: A free and open source platform runner game. Alex depends on public transportation and needs to run to catch the bus, or wait an eternity for the next one.
items.install_note: Ready to run. D-pad to move, A/B/X to jump, Start to pause.

items.name: Alice In Clicheland
items.description: Alice in Clicheland is a game developed for Digital Games Development course, taken during their Computer Science grad school at UFMG. It is an action RPG game, where the action takes place in real time. With its 2D graphics and aerial view, Alice in Clicheland recalls SNES RPG games, like Final Fan
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Alien Blaster
items.description: Alien Blaster is a classic 2D shoot 'em up featuring lots of different weapons, special items, aliens to blast and a big bad boss. Your mission is simple: Stop the invasion of the aliens and blast them!
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Alien Pogs From Outer Space
items.description: This Bullet Heaven Survival game was made for GBJam11 from Sept 15-25 2023 .
items.install_note: Download the game from itch , extract zip file and copy .rpg file into the alienpogs port folder.

items.name: Alien Squatter
items.description: You are a homeless extraterrestrial living in a futuristic version of Japan. Humans are nearly extinct and Earth is a cesspool of pollution, urban decay, and economic inequality. Struggle to survive in this new style of RPG.
items.install_note: Download any version of the game from Steam or [Itch.io](https://willyelektrix.itch.io/alien-squatter), extract the zip file and copy the asquatter.rpg file into the the aliensquatter port folder.

items.name: AlllCALL
items.description: This is a mini shmup. The boss appears when 8 large numbered enemies are defeated. The stage is cleared when the boss is defeated.
items.install_note: Download free at itch.io https://nizakashii.itch.io/alllcall and copy the data.win file into the assets folder.

items.name: Alruna and the Necro-Industrialists
items.description: Welcome to a compact, tightly packed Metroidvania, where the Square Aspect Ratio and Single Screen Level Design allows every one of the 200+ rooms to slot into the larger puzzle-box of the world; where secrets, exploits and sequence-breaking are built into the very foundation of the game; and where
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into the assets folder.

items.name: Always Surrender
items.description: Always Surrender is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up score attack, with an emphasis on pushing your luck as far as you can. Last as long as possible against an endless horde of enemies and then surrender in order to bank the bonus. Giving up has never been so rewarding. Battle a never ending swar
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

items.name: AM2R
items.description: Another Metroid 2 Remake. An action-adventure game developed by Argentinian programmer Milton Guasti (also known as DoctorM64).
items.install_note: Copy your own am2r v1.1 zip file into ports/am2r/assets folder.

items.name: Ambidextro
items.description: Ambidextro is a multiplayer for a single player. Learn to control two characters at the same time, one with each hand. Develop your ambidexterity and rescue both the prince and the princess simultaneously.
items.install_note: Copy the file Ambidextro.pck into the folder: /roms/ports/ambidextro/

items.name: Amoebax
items.description: Amoebax is a cute and addictive action-puzzle game. Due an awful mutation, some amoeba's species have started to multiply until they take the world if you can't stop them. Fortunately the mutation made then too unstable and lining up four or more will make them disappear.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Amphetamine
items.description: Jump'n run platformer with colored lighting, fogging and corona effects. Fight eleven evil monsters with your magic weapons.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Amulets & Armor
items.description: 1997 first-person dungeon-crawler RPG, released as open source by ExiguusEntertainment.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Anarch
items.description: Anarch is extremely small, completely public domain, no-dependency, no-file, portable suckless anarcho-pacifist from-scratch 90s-style Doom clone that runs everywhere, made for the benefit of all living beings
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Angband
items.description: Angband is a free, single-player dungeon exploration game. You play an adventurer seeking riches, fighting monsters, and preparing for a final battle with Morgoth, the Lord of Darkness.
items.install_note: Game files are already included. Controls are rather complex, make sure to read the control sheet on our website carefully.

items.name: Annalynn
items.description: Annalynn is a 2D platformer made in the style of arcade games from the early '80s. Play as Annalynn, the eponymous heroine who has to run, jump, and climb to outwit the four snakes: Randy, Handy, Candy, and Mike. Collect the coins, grab the bonus foods, and turn the tables with blinding rubies! Thin
items.install_note: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1508460/Annalynn/ Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the 1.3 version by typing: download_depot 1508460 1508461 5365853075598347936 in the console. When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files to /ports/annalynn/assets

items.name: Annulus
items.description: Afraid of the dark? Turning the lights on just might be more dangerous... You have arrived on the the Annulus, a space station here to reap all of your home world's power. You can channel this power freely through you, but strange and twisted machines are here to take it. Navigate the dark corridors
items.install_note: Download Annulus 2.31.exe from here - https://toq-games.itch.io/annulus - rename exe to zip and extract contents to ports/annulus/assets folder. Launch the game and Enjoy!

items.name: Antecrypt
items.description: Shoot corrupting monsters and save mankind's last hard-drive with your rechargeable laser-beam! ... But your aiming has a mind of its own, so you'll have to make do!
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and copy the antecrypt.app into gamedata. For Steam, download the MacOS version using the following Steam console command: download_depot 1659920 1659922 959787945917647264, and then copy the files into gamedata.

items.name: Antonball Classic
items.description: After a long night on the town, Anton's struggling to find his way back home. You'll have to help Anton out by using your balls to break the bricks! You'll also run into pesky Ballbusters during your adventure together. Get rid of them by smacking them with your balls, or hitting them from behind!
items.install_note: Download the game on itch.io https://summitsphere.itch.io/antonball and unzip all game data to antonballclassic/assets.

items.name: Antonball Deluxe
items.description: The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.
items.install_note: Purchase the game from Steam and use Steam Console to get the correct version of the game. Enter this command- "download_depot 1382320 1382321 918226394225802310" Once this is done, It will tell you the location of these downloaded files. Copy them into the assets folder.

items.name: Apoc Runner
items.description: As the world burns, as the streets crumble, you cling to one thing: Survival. An unstoppable alien blight has taken hold of the earth, and there's no fighting it. Escape is the only option. Run, jump, and slide your way through urban destruction in this intense runner!
items.install_note: Thanks to Omnitron Studios, there is no need to download the game from itch.io to obtain the game files. This port is 'Ready to Run' as soon as it's been installed on your device.

items.name: A Pond Beyond
items.description: A short puzzle platformer where you play as a tiny frog who must make their way to a pond beyond and avoid many dangers along the way. There are many flies to eat during your adventure, pause the game at any time to view how many you've got.
items.install_note: Download A Pond Beyond.zip (August 16, 2024) from https://npjarcade.itch.io/a-pond-beyond. Copy the data.win from the zip over to apondbeyond/assets.

items.name: Apotris
items.description: Apotris is a block stacking game in the style of Tetris! It features satisfying graphics, responsive controls and a large amount of customization so that you can tailor the game to your preferences! There are 11 game-modes to explore, with various options to keep yourself entertained (or challenged)
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Apple Rabble Dazzle
items.description: The fruit of the Great Tree grows all year long. To claim it, one must follow the Mazana Tribe's ritual.
items.install_note: Download the 1.1.2 VM compile from itch.io https://bolhut.itch.io/apple-rabble-dazzle and copy all of the files into `ports/applerabbledazzle/assets/`.

items.name: Apricots
items.description: Apricots has nothing to do with apricots. It's a game where you fly a little plane around the screen and shoot things and drop bombs on enemy targets, and it's meant to be quick and fun. Big thanks to [Moggers87](https://github.com/moggers87/apricots) for producing this game. The [source](https://gi
items.install_note: At present there is no option screen. Options can be changed by editing the configuration file apricots.cfg. This is first searched for in ~/.config/apricots/, then the system configuration directory (usually /usr/local/etc or /etc) and finally the default configuration in the data directory. The number and type of planes can be varied, along with the airbases, as can 1/2 player game be chosen. The number of anti aircraft guns and scenery can be selected. Draks can be turned on or off, and a dif

items.name: April Dabble Dazzle
items.description: The fruit of the Great Tree grows all year long. To claim it, one must follow the Mazana Tribe's ritual.
items.install_note: Download the VM compile from itch.io https://gifteador.itch.io/april-dabble-dazzle, extract, and copy all of the files into `ports/aprildabbledazzle/assets/`.

items.name: Aquaria
items.description: A massive ocean world, teeming with life and filled with ancient secrets. Join Naija, a lone underwater dweller in search of her family, as she explores the depths of Aquaria. She'll travel from hidden caves, shrouded in darkness, to beautiful, sunlit oases, all lovingly handcrafted by its two creat
items.install_note: Install the port. Buy the game on Steam or GoG and copy the game files (data/ and surrounding files) into your ports/aquaria folder.

items.name: Arcanum Community Edition
items.description: A steampunk isometric RPG from Troika Games where you can freely mix magic and technology.
items.install_note: Copy your own purchased Arcanum data files (tig.dat, arcanum1-4.dat, modules/) into the port's arcanumce/gamedata folder before launching. See README for details.

items.name: Arco
items.description: A Mesoamerican fantasy RPG that blends turn-based and real-time combat. Explore the world through three handcrafted stories forged in bloodshed, laced with magic, and united by revenge. This port does not work with the demo files!
items.install_note: Copy arco.exe from your Steam download to ports/arco. A D-pad/L-stick toggle patch is available during installation.

items.name: AREA2048
items.description: Fast-paced omni-directional arena shooter.
items.install_note: Clear a scene by destroying all the enemies that are in the scene. If you touch an enemy body or enemy bullet, you loose a life. When you clear 10 scenes, you proceed to the next area. The game is complete when five areas are cleared. If all areas can't be cleared in the time limit, it's game over.

items.name: Arengius
items.description: The whole galactic federation is under attack by the gigantic organism known only as Arengius! With the federation army under attack on all fronts, only you have a chance to stop Arengius and save the galaxy! The game offers 13 stages full of unique hazards and powerful bosses.
items.install_note: Download the game (both Lite and Full version works) from https://yaru.itch.io/arengius and place the zip file into the assets folder.

items.name: Arkovs Tower
items.description: This roguelike puts you in the shoes of an unnamed adventurer who just woke up on the top level of Arkov's Tower. Try to fight your way down and escape it - or die trying. Move your player trough numerous procedural generated levels. Fight numerous enemies including some unique bosses. The turn base
items.install_note: Includes the Arkovs Tower Prologue version. If you enjoy the game, please consider adding the full version to your steam wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876720/Descent_from_Arkovs_Tower/

items.name: Armagetron Advanced
items.description: 3D Tron-like high speed game
items.install_note: Ready to run! Control Player 1 via DPAD and Player 2 via ABY

items.name: Armor Stride
items.description: Sir Stepsalot is trapped in the Cursed Forest! Armed with his sword and bomb pouch, he must fight monsters, dodge traps, and seek treasure to sell. But he can't linger -- something dark is chasing him through the woods.
items.install_note: Purchase from itch.io (https://sralbertooo.itch.io/armor-stride), and download the 'Armor Stride Stand-Alone' version. Then, extract and copy the game files to the armorstride/assets folder

items.name: Arx
items.description: The world of Arx is wrought with turmoil, brought to the brink of destruction by a violent war. It is set on a world whose sun has failed, forcing the above-ground creatures to take refuge in caverns. Arx Fatalis is an innovative first-person role-playing game, featuring crafting, combat and spell-c
items.install_note: Purchase the game and copy the GoG offline installer (2 files, setup_arx...exe and setup_arx...bin) to arx/gamedata. They will be extracted on first run. Alternatively, copy Steam or Windows CD-ROM files so that copy them so that data.pak and surrounding files and folders are in arx/gamedata.

items.name: Advanced Strategic Command
items.description: A free, open-source turn-based hex wargame in the tradition of Battle Isle 2/3. Command land, sea, and air units to eliminate your opponent across dozens of bundled maps and campaigns.
items.install_note: Ready to run, all game data is bundled, no additional files needed.

items.name: Ascent DX
items.description: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
items.install_note: This game is ready to run! Special thanks to Johan Peitz for allowing PortMaster to distribute the game!

items.name: ASSAULT SHELL
items.description: Engage in an action packed shoot em' up adventure! Choose from 4 powerful fighters and fight through 5 intense stages!
items.install_note: Purchase from itch.io https://overloadedstudios.itch.io/assault-shell or Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432970/ASSAULT_SHELL/ and place data.win, each audiogroup.dat file, and each .csv file into gamedata folder.

items.name: asteroludi
items.description: Drifting through space, blasting rocks, enjoying the silence — it begins like a calm round of Asteroids. But you’re not out here just for fun. You’re mining. And soon, you realize... you’re not alone.
items.install_note: Use the left stick or D-Pad to navigate your ship. Use the right stick or face buttons to aim and shoot your weapons. Extract minerals from asteroids by firing your mining laser and fly close to collect them. But be careful not to get too close to large asteroids or enemy ships, as collisions can easily damage or destroy your ship. Sometimes, collisions can be avoided by activating your shields (right shoulder button), but they consume energy quickly.

items.name: Astronautilus
items.description: Your ship has crash-landed on a stray rogue planet, and you're out of fuel ... It's up to you to delve beneath the frozen surface and find a way to get your ship back into space. Fight strange sea creatures and uncover the mysteries of the world beneath the ice!
items.install_note: Purchase the game from Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724120/ASTRONAUTILUS/). Enter the Steam Console and use the following command to download a compatible version: download_depot 1724120 1724121 6233168631671934006. Copy those downloaded files to the astronautilus/assets directory.

items.name: Asylum
items.description: Young Sigmund has a few problems. To help him resolve his mental instability you must enter the surreal world of his inner mind and shut down the malfunctioning brain cells. Guide Sigmund through the Ego, Psyche and Id zones - each one 300 times the size of the screen - to locate the eight renegade
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Attrition
items.description: Welcome to a world trapped in perpetual fighting. Attrition is a turn-based strategy game where three countries, Lutem, Bertas, and Cualitas, are constantly at war with one-another. Command their armies in a story of opposite opinions, sacrifices for one’s beliefs, and the quest for a greater goal.
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Itch.io, download the zip with game and extract all files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

items.name: Audiofilus
items.description: A pixel-art music player that keeps playing while you game. Send it to the background and control it with hotkeys, or turn the screen off and control it from your pocket. Plays your library, internet radio, podcasts and Subsonic/Jellyfin servers.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Put your music (MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WAV, AIFF, MOD/XM/IT) in a folder and pick it on the first run.

items.name: Augustus
items.description: A reimplemntation of the Caeser 3 engine.
items.install_note: You will need the original files of the PC release copied to the ports/augustus/data folder.

items.name: Aliens versus Predator
items.description: The three most ferocious species in the universe in a bloodthirsty battle for the ultimate prize: survival. Take your pick: be a Colonial Marine, a Predator or an Alien. Fight through suspense-filled environments: from starships and space stations to colonial bases and eerie planetscapes. One wrong
items.install_note: You will need the original files of the 1999 PC release copied to the ports/avp folder.

items.name: Axe Cop
items.description: Fight all of the bad guys! Axe Cop and his team of colorful characters must go on an epic adventure, that covers his ten-year comic book history, to rid the world of all bad guys once and for all in this epic turn-based RPG!
items.install_note: Purchase the game from https://redtrianglegames.itch.io/axecop or https://store.steampowered.com/app/1193300/Axe_Cop and download the Windows version (Linux should work fine, too). Copy the file named axecop.rpg to the port directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch page).

items.name: Azimuth
items.description: Azimuth is a metroidvania game, and something of an homage to the previous greats of the genre (Super Metroid in particular).
items.install_note: Ready to run! For detailed instructions visit https://mdsteele.games/azimuth/manual.html

items.name: Bab Be U
items.description: A fan game of Baba Is You: a puzzle game where the rules you follow are represented as physical blocks you can push around and recombine.
items.install_note: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.

items.name: Crypt of Baconthulhu
items.description: At a picnic with friends, Bob the Hamster eats so much bacon that he blacks out. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a mysterious crypt filled with dangerous monsters, ominous cultists, and whispers of the dreaded BACONTHULHU! If you love bacon and you love mazes, this is the game for you! ... If

items.name: Balatro
items.description: Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big.
items.install_note: Purchase the game from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/. On macOS, copy Balatro.love from Balatro.app/Contents/Resources into the balatro folder. On Windows, copy Balatro.exe into the balatro folder.

items.name: Balloon Challenge
items.description: Balloon Challenge is William Soleau's 1993 DOS strategy game: launch your 25 balloons into a sky full of airplanes, dark clouds, directional clouds, hurricanes and bonus clouds, and get them higher than the computer's.
items.install_note: Ready to run. The shareware game files are included. Owners of the registered version can copy their files over the included ones in ports/balloonchallenge/gamedata/ to play against a second human player.

items.name: Banana Duck
items.description: Experience the sweet taste of pursuing bananas and avoiding all the evil vegetables and saw blades that are there for absolutely no reason. Also, you're a duck that can't swim and dies when it touches the water.
items.install_note: Game files are already included and ready to go.

items.name: Barbarian
items.description: Barbarian is a fighting game that gives players control over sword-wielding barbarians.
items.install_note: Go to https://www.tdbsoft.com/html/projects/barbarian.html, download the linux version and extract the files to the barbarian gamedata folder.

items.name: Bar Hop
items.description: A rhythm game inspired by Frogger. Hop to the bar and back for 7 days straight without getting hit or falling in. Each day gets harder. Earn points for every hop, coin, and safe return.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: barrel roll
items.description: Barrel roll is a puzzle game that makes you think outside the barrel to find solutions to each level. You're a cute little guy named Bruno who just woke up in this abandoned castle, your mission is to go around sorting all kinds of button puzzles with your trusty barrel!
items.install_note: Download the game directly from the itch.io website. Extract the files and place them in the ports/barrelroll/assets directory.

items.name: Battalion
items.description: Your lands have been invaded by General Mustache and his infamous armored division! Nothing seems to stop him, except perhaps for Commander Joe and his old companion "G-080 Justice" tank destroyer. Engage in 8 exciting battles through the liberation campaign. Fight in cities, forests, riverbanks, mi
items.install_note: READY to RUN

items.name: Blues Brothers: Jukebox Adventure
items.description: A rewrite of the Blues Brothers game engine developed by Titus Interactive.

items.name: Super Hydorah
items.description: Super Hydorah is a nonlinear horizontal shoot' em up designed to offer a challenging experience, sublimating the richness of traditional shmup classics.
items.install_note: Purchase and download the game on steam. Copy the data.win file and the texts and music folders inside gamedata. Then Boot the game from Hydorah.sh

items.name: Hydra Castle Labyrinth
items.description: Hydra Castle Labyrinth is a platform game with some old school action. It's also reminiscent of games of the 16 bit era.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Hylics
items.description: Hylics is a surrealistic stop-motion style JRPG game created by Mason Lindroth. It boasts unique claymation graphics, RPG battles, and "overuse of random text generation", spread across 2+ hours of content. It's praised for its abstract, uncanny art style, as well as its alien atmosphere.
items.install_note: Buy the game on Steam or itch.io Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/397740/Hylics/ itch.io: https://mason-lindroth.itch.io/ Download it and copy all the files from the game folder into the portfolder. If you bought the game on itch.io, just put the .exe file into the portfolder.

items.name: Hypercycles
items.description: A raycasting first-person shooter, ported from the 1995 DOS game Hypercycles.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Hyper Overlap 2: Turbo Edition
items.description: In the future year of 199X, the world was finally united in 7 grand cartridges. But one day, the [Glitch Wizard] decided to take it one step further! Play every game at once (not in a good way!) as you fight against the glitches and corruption.
items.install_note: Download the game from Itch.io and extract all files into the assets folder.

items.name: Hyper Princess Pitch
items.description: The good Mecha Santa plans to spread happiness and cheer all over the world. Princess Pitch, previously just a sidekick in Garden Gnome Carnage, sets out to put an end to those silly plans. Hyper Princess Pitch is sort of a remake of DOS Operation: Carnage, keeping the fast-paced arcade action, shor
items.install_note: Ready to Run!

items.name: Ichorous
items.description: A long-imprisoned God of Blood has made you their disciple. Kill their monstrosities still roaming the land and return the godly blood, Ichor, to restore your Patron to their full power. Master the Offerings of The Patron and combine them for crazy synergies and boosts!
items.install_note: Download the game from itch.io and place the data.win in ports/ichorous/gamedata

items.name: Iconoclasts
items.description: A platformer that offers fun and wacky gameplay. Recommended only for 640x480 devices or better.
items.install_note: You must have a copy of Iconoclasts for Linux copied to the ports/iconoclasts/gamedata folder. Be sure the folder contains subfolders named 32, 64 and data.

items.name: Icy Tower
items.description: Reach new heights by jumping from platform to platform in the Icy Tower game!
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: I Gacha Head
items.description: A puzzle game where the top of your head falls off when you walk into low platforms.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Thanks to Dylan Brown (https://dylanbrowngames.itch.io) for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

items.name: iiChantra
items.description: iiChantra is a cross-platform 2D-Action, «retro» in style but modern in gameplay.
items.install_note: iiChantra files are already included and ready to go.

items.name: iii
items.description: A little 'catroidvania' about a one-eyed cat leaving his comfort zone. Explore underground caverns, gain vision of other dimensions, help the inhabitants, and expand your horizons.
items.install_note: Download the game (free) on itch.io (https://yukonw.itch.io/iii), extract it, and copy the game files to the port's gamedata folder.

items.name: Ikemen
items.description: An open-source fighting game engine that supports M.U.G.E.N resources.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Use Ports -> IkemenGamepad to remap input. Use Ports -> IkemenDebug to debug

items.name: ImageStriker
items.description: This game is a 2D vertical scrolling shooter. You can operate the fighter “Image Striker” to fire shots and destroy enemies in 6 stages.
items.install_note: Download the game from Steam for free and copy game files into assets folder.

items.name: ImageStriker2
items.description: ImageStriker2 is a vertical scroll Shoot 'em up made to pay homage to ImageFight, featuring 7 stages, Arcade Mode and 3 minutes score attack Caravan mode.
items.install_note: Download the game from Itch.io and copy the ImageStriker2.exe into the assets folder.

items.name: Impostor Factory
items.description: A narrative-driven RPG Maker game from Freebird Games, continuing the story told in To the Moon and Finding Paradise.
items.install_note: Buy the game from your favorite store Steam / GOG and copy the gamedata of your game to impostorfactory/gamedata/. If using the GOG linux version, place the impostor_factory_*.sh installer at the root of the impostorfactory folder, or extract the contents of data/noarch/game/ into impostorfactory/gamedata/.

items.name: Inertia Blast
items.description: The rebellion captured several warships but lack the energy pod to power the ships. You are part of a risky expedition to steal the energy pods. Defense systems will attempt to stop you. The energy pods are often stored in tunnels making them hard to retrieve. The massive weight of the pod increases
items.install_note: Inertia Blast is a remake of an C64 game called Thrust.

items.name: Inferna
items.description: Originally made in 1 week for the 8x8 Game Jam! Charge and burn your way through a labyrinthine complex as a ball of fire!
items.install_note: This game is Ready to Run!

items.name: Infested
items.description: A point-and-click game where you must find your way through an infested space ship. Discover a way to escape using the resources and environment around you.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Thanks to Grahf Metal (https://grahfmetal.itch.io) for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

items.name: Infra Arcana
items.description: Infra Arcana is a Roguelike set in the early 20th century. The goal is to explore the lair of a dreaded cult called The Church of Starry Wisdom. Buried deep beneath their hallowed grounds lies an artefact called The Shining Trapezohedron - a window to all secrets of the universe. Your ultimate goal
items.install_note: All game files are included. The controls are rather complex, carefully study the instructions for the controls.

items.name: INK
items.description: INK is a fast-paced platformer about using colorful paint to uncover your surroundings. Defeat all enemies in the room and reach the goal! However, the terrain is invisible, so you need to discover the terrain by physically bumping into it, by performing a double jump or by, well, dying.
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam. Copy INK.exe to ports/INK.

items.name: Insaniquarium Deluxe
items.description: Insaniquarium Deluxe (PopCap, 2004) running natively on aarch64. Not an emulator: this is the WinFish decompilation of the game, ported from the original SexyAppFramework to PopLib, which replaces DirectDraw with SDL3. Module music is played with libopenmpt. The binary is native aarch64 and depends
items.install_note: This port does NOT include the game. Copy the data, images, music, properties, sounds and fishsongs folders from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe (Steam) into ports/insaniquarium/. Watch the letter case: Windows ignores it and Linux does not. If the game complains about an image that clearly exists, that is almost always why.

items.name: Interstate Drifter 1999
items.description: Drift between the states, collect bits, beat rivals and get a high score.
items.install_note: Download the game for free on Steam or Itch. Right click game in steam library, browse local files. Copy "Interstate Drifter 1999.exe" or "Interstate Drifter 1999 itch.exe" to "roms/ports/interstatedrifter/assets"

items.name: Invaders
items.description: A memory accurate reimplementation of Space Invaders by loadzero.
items.install_note: You'll need to provide your own invaders.e, invaders.f, invaders.g, and invaders.h files from a MAME_078 romset into the invaders/inv1 folder.

items.name: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers
items.description: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers is a free narrative-driven point-and-click adventure that explores the stories of four different characters in a masked ball taking place on a train in the late 1920s.
items.install_note: Download the windows version of the game on Itch or Steam. Copy all assets, including the executable, into the gamedata folder.

items.name: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
items.description: Return to Castle Wolfenstein using the iortcw project. With porting work done by JohnnyonFlame. Packaged by Romadu.
items.install_note: You'll need to add your own pak0.pk3, sp_pak1.pk3, sp_pak2.pk3, and sp_pak3.pk3 to the ports/iortcw/main folder.

items.name: IRON FERRET
items.description: Iron Ferret Is a small game where you play as a ferret riding a tank. Ultimately it's one giant escort mission, but at least your escortee is much more tankier than you and can shoot bullets.
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: It Came from the Forest
items.description: A 2D dungeon crawler inspired by old classics and made using similar techniques as back then. No 3D here, just simple 2D graphics painted back to front (Painter's Algorithm).
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: ITTA
items.description: ITTA is a bullet-hell adventure set in a world filled with monstrous bosses. When Itta wakes up and finds herself surrounded by her dead family, her only guide is a strange spirit that takes the form of the family cat who gifts her a glowing revolver for protection.
items.install_note: Download the latest version of the game from Steam OR GOG Copy all the game files over to ports/itta/gamedata

items.name: Ittle Dew
items.description: A short and sweet puzzle adventure. Ittle and her fairy fox Tippsie wash up on an island full of monsters, dungeons and treasure, and set out to find it all.
items.install_note: Any GOG or Steam version (Linux, Windows or Mac). GOG: copy the installer (.sh, .exe or .dmg) into ports/ittledew/gamedata. Steam: copy the game's files (Windows: dew.exe and dew_Data; Mac: IttleDew.app; Linux: IttleDew.x86 and IttleDew_Data) into ports/ittledew/gamedata.

items.name: In Your Face City Trains
items.description: A one-button runner: get to work on time by jumping over closed trains, running through open ones and dodging birds and tunnels. Coffee from open trains gives an extra life.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Izel's Observatory
items.description: You are Izel, and your passion is studying the stars. But your discoveries threaten the power of the high priests. They destroy your research and sentence you to execution. Escape from jail and take up your spear -- fight your way through underwater caverns, coral reefs, a nest of electric eels, a s
items.install_note: Ready To Run

items.name: Jazz2 Resurrection
items.description: "Jazz² Resurrection" is a reimplementation of "Jazz Jackrabbit 2", a superb 2D platformer released in 1998 by Epic Megagames as a sequel to the shareware classic "Jazz Jackrabbit" (also available on PortMaster). Supports various versions of the game (Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (v1.20/1.23), as well as Sharew
items.install_note: Copy the contents of your original "Jazz Jackrabbit 2" game directory to "ports/jazz2/Source/". Cache files will be recreated during the intro cutscene the first time the game is run, so it can't be skipped. The intro cutscene's sound effects require these cache files, so they will be missing the first time the game is run.

items.name: Jester's Helper
items.description: Collect all of the cherries before the executioners catch you.
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: Jetboard Joust
items.description: Fast & fluid arcade-style shooter with roguelike elements! Take flight on a lethal rocket-powered jetboard, blasting alien invaders with an explosive arsenal of ridiculous weaponry. Face off against massive, multi-stage bosses. Jetboard Joust resurrects the spirit of the arcade for the 21st century!
items.install_note: Buy and install the Linux version of Jetboard Joust from Steam or GOG. Copy all the game assets to jetboardjoust/gamedata. For GOG, you can place the offline installer in jetboardjoust/gamedata as well.

items.name: Jet Set Willy
items.description: Jet Set Willy is a flip-screen platform game in which the player moves the protagonist, Willy, from room to room in his mansion collecting objects. Unlike the screen-by-screen style of its prequel, the player can explore the mansion at will. Willy is controlled using only left, right and jump.
items.install_note: Ready to play

items.name: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey
items.description: Welcome to Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey! It's a game inspired by NES classics, such as Super Mario Bros., Mega Man 2 and Ice Climbers. items.install_note: Ready to run.

Each level, the player is required to jump off the bridge, but dying in any other sense, is failure. You may encounter characters that require items, methodical puzzle levels, intensely difficult platforming,
items.install_note: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057780/Jump_Off_The_Bridge/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on Jump Off The Bridge > Manage > Browse local files. Copy the data.win, audiogroup2.dat and audiogroup3.dat from the assets folder to /ports/jumpoffthebridge/gamedata

items.name: Jump on Head
items.description: A platform fighter with one goal: JUMP ON HEAD. Casuals and pros alike can enjoy its fast-paced, responsive gameplay. Play against a friend (local multiplayer only) on six diverse stages, and try to be the last player standing!
items.install_note: Purchase the game on itch.io (https://organzola.itch.io/jumponhead), download the JUMP ON HEAD.exe version and copy this file to the port's gamedata folder.

items.name: Just Another Pong
items.description: It's just another pong game. Play alone or with a friend, each holding one side of your handheld!

items.install_note: Ready to run

Copy the game file named kaiju.rpg to the port directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch page) -- but using the file named kaijudemo.rpg

items.name: Kaima

items.install_note: Download the game from Itch, https://nomnomnami.itch.io/kaima tested with Windows version. Copy all assets to the gamedata folder. Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays.

items.name: Kanon
items.description: Kanon is a visual novel that follows Yuichi Aizawa's return to a town where he reconnects with childhood friends and encounters new ones, each with hidden pasts and supernatural ties. As Yuichi unravels their stories, themes of love, forgiveness, and second chances intertwine in this emotionally cha
items.install_note: Add your game assets to `ports/kanon/gamedata`.

items.name: Kemono Rogue
items.description: Based on a Japanese Anime, KemonoRogue is a fun map adventure game! Move your character through each level of the map, attacking foes and collecting coins on the way.
items.install_note: Ready to play!

items.name: Kleebuu Craves Fruit Salad

items.install_note: Ready to run. Thanks to Dylan Brown (https://dylanbrowngames.itch.io) for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

items.name: Klorets
items.description: Simple bullet hell shooter from the creator of Magic Vigilante
items.install_note: Download game from https://nizakashii.itch.io/klorets , copy data.win to /ports/klorets/gamedata

items.install_note: All files are included and game is ready to play.

items.name: Kondor
items.description: QSoft's 1999 freeware top-down tank game. Drive through twelve levels, wipe out every turret and ground vehicle, and survive jets and hawks attacking from the air.
items.install_note: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.

items.name: Kor
items.description: Kor is a retro RPG with a variety of eccentric characters, goofy dialog, and turn-based combat where - in addition to strategizing - players must skillfully execute button combos in order to make attacks!
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into assets folder.

items.name: KOReader
items.description: KOReader is a super flexible reading app that lets you enjoy ebooks, PDFs, and more just the way you like. With features like custom fonts, easy zooming, and built-in dictionaries, it makes reading comfy and fun. Great for book lovers who wants to read on a Handheld📚💫
items.install_note: Add yours books to the ports/koreader/books folder

items.name: Kudamono Merge
items.description: Kudamono Merge is a retro-style puzzle game made with Pyxel. Drop and merge identical fruits to evolve them into bigger ones. Keep stacking and aim for a high score! Inspired by Suika Game, but with a classic 8-bit twist.
items.install_note: Download the game at https://takeshic.itch.io/kudamono-merge, and place the KudamonoMerge.pyxapp file in the kudamonomerge/gamedata folder.

items.name: Kuklomenos
items.description: An abstract shoot-em-up. Minimalistic graphics, short game-length. Gameplay lies somewhere between Centipede and Starship Command. Very challenging at the higher difficulty levels. Can you make Elite?
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: La-Mulana
items.description: La-Mulana is an 'Archaeological Ruin Exploration Action Game' in the vein of classic MSX platformers. As a daring archaeologist you venture inside the ancient ruins of the Mayan city La-Mulana, seeking out the Secret Treasure of Life. Apart from the plethora of traps lying in wait to stop intruders,
items.install_note: Buy the game on gog.com, download the offline installer (gog_la_mulana_2.0.0.1.sh), and copy it to `ports/la-mulana/gamedata`. When you launch the game for the first time, there will be a short delay while the files are automatically extracted.

items.name: Labyrinth of Legendary Loot
items.description: Labyrinth of Legendary Loot is a simple turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler focused on tactical combat. Every room is almost like a puzzle as you try to figure out the best way to defeat all enemies without taking too much damage.
items.install_note: All files are included

items.name: Lasagna Boy Classic
items.description: A puzzle horror game with a gameboy aesthetic.
items.install_note: Ready To Run!

items.name: Laser Kombat
items.description: Laser Kombat is a classic puzzle game, now available for modern systems. Destroy all the tanks to beat the level. Stay out of line of sight, though, or you will get shot. Shoot your lasers at mirrors, blow up bomb or push your enemies into water with movable blocks to win.
items.install_note: All files are included and game is ready to play

items.name: Last Mission
items.description: The Last Mission is a side-view arcade game without scrolling (viewpoint moves from screen to screen) with map of big dimensions. The game takes its inspiration from games such as Underwurlde and Starquake.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Last Scenario
items.description: Turn-based RPG following Hilbert, a small-town boy who learns he descends from the legendary demon slayer Alexander and sets out to fulfill that destiny. Party-based battles with Spellcard magic, plus the Hex card minigame.
items.install_note: Download Last Scenario from https://site.scfworks.com/?page_id=8 and extract its contents (Game.rgssad, Audio, etc.) into the port's game folder, then launch.

items.name: Lawn Buster for Hire
items.description: Play as Lawn Buster and trim the grass in randomly generated lawn levels, following an increasingly complex series of rules and priorities.
items.install_note: You can purchase Lawn Buster for Hire at: https://turdboomerang.itch.io/lawn-buster-for-hire. Download the *Lawn Buster for Hire.zip* and extract it, and place the *Lawn Buster for Hire.exe* file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with the *Lawn Buster for Hire.zip*, Mar 01, 2022 release.

items.name: Professor Layton Curious Village HD
items.description: A remaster of the puzzle-adventure classic. Professor Layton and his apprentice Luke arrive in the village of St. Mystere to solve the mystery of the Golden Apple, and find a place where every resident answers a question with a riddle. Over 130 puzzles, hand-drawn art and fully animated cutscenes, r
items.install_note: Purchase Layton: Curious Village in HD on Google Play and install it on an Android device. Install SAI: https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI/releases/tag/4.5 on that device. In SAI, open the Backup tab, find Layton: Curious Village in HD, and export it. The game is a split install, so this produces an APK file containing several APKs rather than a single one. Copy the APK to your computer, rename it to .zip and extract it. You only need two of the pieces: - "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk" — contains "lib/"

items.name: LBreakoutHD
items.description: LBreakoutHD is a scaleable 16:9 remake of LBreakout2. You try to clear levels full of different types of bricks and extras by using your paddle to aim balls at the bricks.
items.install_note: All files are included and game is ready to play.

items.name: Lead Haul
items.description: Lead Haul is a short old-school first person shooter with an emphasis on powerful weapons and a sprinkling of secret hunting
items.install_note: This game is ready to run! In the Menu, Use R-stick to move the cursor and press R1 / R2 to select the button.

items.name: Leap Year
items.description: Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery. Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.
items.install_note: Purchase and download the game from Itch https://managore.itch.io/leap-year Locate your gamefolder and copy all the files from the folder to leapyear/assets/

items.name: Leap Year: March
items.description: Continues the adventure for players who have beaten Leap Year and want an even greater challenge. Use the same tools you learned to explore another hand-drawn world that's both larger and much more complex. Master your understanding of the game's secrets to complete another month of your calendar.
items.install_note: Purchase and download the game from itch.io (https://managore.itch.io/leap-year-march), extract, and copy game files to leapyearmarch/assets. For less powerful devices (like RK3326), rename data.win to data_potato.win

items.name: LGeneral
items.description: A turn-based hex strategy game in the spirit of Panzer General. Command your forces through single scenarios or full campaigns against the AI, with entrenchment, supply, weather, surprise contacts and reinforcements shaping every battle.
items.install_note: Ready to run, no additional files needed.

items.name: Spotify Connect
items.description: Spotify Connect uses Librespot which allows you to stream music to your handheld via Spotify Premium. It even works in the background, allowing you to play music, no matter what your doing on your handheld!
items.install_note: This port is ready to run: - Install "Spotify Connect" port. - Open the port and toggle it on. - Select your handheld in Spotify devices on your Desktop or phone. - Close app if you want to play games. (L1 + R1) - The app dynamically registers if Spotify is running, so if you want to turn it off, just open the port again and use the toggle switch.

items.name: LieroLibre
items.description: Liero is a simple game. Pick your five weapons, and unleash your inner fury.
items.install_note: This game is ready to run.

items.name: LILT
items.description: A musical grid for small computers. Place notes on a sixteen by eight grid and let them loop, then shape the sound with echo, space, pace and wobble across nine generated voices. Simple enough for kids, strange enough for everyone else.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Lil Tanks
items.description: A side scrolling shmup where you are a prototype tank, defending humanity from the onslaught of alien lifeforms.
items.install_note: Purchase on Steam from Lead Money Games (https://store.steampowered.com/app/495820/Lil_Tanks/) Locate data.win file and place it into the gamedata folder.

items.name: Limbo
items.description: Monochrome puzzle-platformer from Playdead. A boy wakes alone in a forest and must solve his way through it and a derelict, industrial world beyond, guided by nothing but silhouette, shadow and atmosphere. No dialogue, no HUD, just physics puzzles, traps, and a signature grain-and-fog visual style.
items.install_note: - Purchase Limbo (Mobile) on the Epic Games Store (store.epicgames.com/p/limbo-mobile-android-300111?lang=en-US) (Play Store version WILL NOT work!)and install it on an Android device. - Extract the installed APK (single APK, no split install, any APK extractor or adb pull works). - Use 7zip to unzip the .apk file. - Copy the whole assets/ and lib/ folders into ports/limbo/. - Run Limbo.

items.name: Line game
items.description: An on-rails bullet hell. Weave past bullets and fill containers through 3 worlds.
items.install_note: Install port zip. Download LineGameWINDOWS.zip file from the Itch. Extract zip into the ports/linegame/assets folder.

items.name: Lineoff
items.description: Clean the dangerous line machine from ancient dust! ✿ unlockable colour palettes ✿
items.install_note: This port is ready to run.

items.name: Linovictus: Portable Edition
items.description: Linovictus is a twin stick arcade shootemup where you play the role of Linovictus: An immune response of the second manifold. Autonomous beings from another world are infiltrating your domain to strip mine resources, threatening the stability of every higher dimension.
items.install_note: Ready to run

items.install_note: Purchase the game either from itch OR steam. Download the game and copy over all the game data to ports/lostpotato/assets

items.name: LOVE by Fred Wood
items.description: LOVE is a short and addictively challenging platformer with a minimalist design. items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: OpenRA
items.description: OpenRA is an open source project that recreates and modernizes classic real time strategy games, like Red Alert, Command & Conquer, and Dune 2000.
items.install_note: The installer automatically takes care of setting up the game. The port comes bundled with Tiberian Dawn (Command & Conquer), Dune 2000 and Red Alert from OpenRA, the Hard Vacuum mod from OpenHV, and the Generals Alpha mod from Mustafa Alperen Seki. When you run a mod for the first time, the game offers to automatically download the free version of the game assets, or you can use the original game disks.

items.name: OpenRCT2
items.description: OpenRCT2 is Open source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2.
items.install_note: Add your Roller Coaster Tycoon 2 game files to the ports/openrct2/RCT2 directory, and optionally add your Roller Coaster Tycoon 1 files to ports/openrct2/RCT1.

items.name: OpenSupaplex
items.description: OpenSupaplex is a 1:1 reimplementation of the original game in C and SDL, with just a few changes to make it easy to use with game controllers, and also easy to port to any platform.
items.install_note: All files are included and game is ready to play. Every levelset requires a there to be a player created. Levelset 1 had a premade PLAYER1 created but all others will require you to create a new one. You can use start + dpad down to enter text input mode.

items.name: Open Surge
items.description: Open Surge is a fun 2D retro platformer inspired by Sonic games, and a game creation system. Play as Surge the Rabbit, a hero who uses his electric powers to rescue his friends from an evil robot.
items.install_note: Ready to run. To play other Open Surge games, drop their .zip/.7z file or folder into opensurge/games and pick them from the menu shown on launch.

items.name: OpenSyobon
items.description: An SDL-based cross-platform port of Syobon Action
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: OpenTTD
items.description: OpenTTD is an open source simulation game based upon Transport Tycoon Deluxe which was originally released in November of 1994.
items.install_note: Everything is included and ready to run.

items.name: OpenTyrian
items.description: OpenTyrian is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian.
items.install_note: OpenTyrian 2.1 files are already included as they were made freeware sometime ago.

items.name: Open Tyrian 2000
items.description: OpenTyrian2000 is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian. It is a fork of OpenTyrian, with the end goal being to replicate the experience of Tyrian 2000 as closely as possible. Tyrian is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shooter. The story is set in 20,031 where you play as Trent Hawkins, a ski
items.install_note: OpenTyrian2000 requires the Tyrian 2000 data files, which have been released as freeware (https://www.camanis.net/tyrian/tyrian2000.zip). Alternatively, the game is also available free of charge on GOG (https://www.gog.com/en/game/tyrian_2000). Game data is placed in the 'tyrian2000' subdirectory.

items.name: OpenXcom Extended
items.description: OXCE is an open source engine for running XCOM:Ufo Defense and Terror From the Deep.
items.install_note: You will need to provide your own UFO Defense/TFTD game files. Read the README-port.txt file for details.

items.name: Operius
items.description: Operius is a game where you shoot and dodge enemies inside a tunnel while going through an infinite amount of levels!
items.install_note: Ready to Run!

items.name: Operius DX
items.description: Blast off into Operius DX, the ultimate evolution of the popular, retro-inspired, high-speed arcade shooter, Operius! Navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle endless waves of enemies, and face off against challenging bosses across infinite sectors. Each run in this game offers a fresh, action-pa
items.install_note: Ready to Run! Game comes with demo files courtesy of Mors! For the full game, purchase and download operius-dx-windows.zip from Itch.io and place the zip in ports/operiusdx/ OR the game files into ports/operiusdx/assets.

items.name: Oquonie
items.description: A textless isometric puzzle game. You must make your way through a seemingly endless succession of rooms. You will not be alone. Your incarnations will have the help of bizaroid characters that speak an obscure language.
items.install_note: Place oquonie.rom from https://hundredrabbits.itch.io/oquonie into the oquonie folder.

items.name: Orcish Skies
items.description: Orcish Skies blends Roguelike deckbuilding, turn-based, Slay The Spire-styled gameplay with a grid-based map. Fire a missile into a cluster of enemies. Rain down lightning on an enemy Carrier from afar. Fly past a swarm of frigates to pick off the sniper shooting you from across the map.
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all games files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

items.name: Osmos
items.description: Osmos is a serene, physics‑based puzzle game where you control a tiny “mote” that grows by absorbing smaller ones while avoiding larger predators, all propelled by ejecting your own mass to move. Each level challenges you to balance growth and movement, with 72 stages set across ambient, sentient, a
items.install_note: This port is compatible with the Demo or Full version from https://osmos-game.com and the Steam version. (Steam version not compatible with TrimUI devices). Free demo: - Download the latest linux demo: https://www.hemispheregames.com/latest_osmos_demo_linux_deb - Place the .deb file in "osmos/installer/webdemo" Full version from website: - Purchase the game on https://www.osmos-game.com/ - Download the latest linux deb installer - Place the .deb file in "osmos/installer/webfull" Steam version: -

items.name: Ot
items.description: Autumn arrived; now Ot must gather the leaves. A 2D grid-based puzzle game with 22 levels.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Otto Matic
items.description: This is Pangea Software’s Otto Matic. Take control of the robot Otto Matic and save earth from aliens from Planet X
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: OutlawN
items.description: Are you ready for 16 levels of OLD WEST LAWN MOWIN' ACTION!? Are you a bad enough buddeh to fight 4 types of lawmen AND snakes while takin' care of a LAWN?! Well, OutlawN is for you!
items.install_note: Download free at itch.io https://programancer.itch.io/outlawn-retrogradejam2 Copy data.win into gamedata folder.

items.name: Out of Ammo
items.description: A mix of retro shmup (think Judgement Silversword) and breakout, in the style of something like The Lost Shield or Wizorb, with aesthetics hugely inspired by ZeroRanger (because it's brilliant, and green+orange goes well with EVERYTHING).
items.install_note: All game files are included

items.name: Overbowed
items.description: Explore a magic-corrupted kingdom in this Game Boy-inspired metroidvania featuring fluid bow combat, interconnected ruins, and secrets to uncover as you fight servants of the Dark Sorcerer.
items.install_note: Purchase the game from itch.io (https://klardonics.itch.io/overbowed) or Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776840/Overbowed) and download. Extract (if itch.io). Copy the game files to the overbowed/assets directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch.io page).

items.name: OverGun
items.description: OverGun is a shoot'em up 2D platform where your character’s weapon is bigger than he can handle! Take control of the crazy pixeled shooter to help him keep control of his gun and bullets through the dungeon.
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: Overwrite
items.description: Push batteries and open gates. Take pictures and change your surroundings. Restore power.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Oxytone
items.description: Oxytone is the ultimate puzzle game, equally easy to learn and challenging to master. Are you ready for a unique adventure like no other? Oxytone invites you to explore the depths of your mind while offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life for those seeking relaxation.
items.install_note: Purchase on Steam or Itch.io and copy game files into assets folder. You can also use demo versions.

items.name: Pachi el Marciano
items.description: Pachi el marciano is a platform game inspired by games like Manic Miner and Jet Set Willy from the legend Mathew Smith. The goal of the game is to collect all the objects of each level, when this is met, the exit gate to the next stage will appear and you can pass through.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: PacMan ROM
items.description: Recent reports have talked about strange symptoms when trying this corrupted ROM of the classic Pacman, we can't confirm or deny it, play it at your own risk.
items.install_note: Ready to Run! Thanks to Berick Cook for giving us permissions to distribute game files!

items.name: Painted Heart
items.description: Near the village of Appleby, a young and aspiring painter, Corbin, is prodded into the cathedral’s painting to cleanse the vibrant world from cultural extinction by the Pestilence. To this day, nobody knows where the Pestilence had come from, and Corbin is even less sure how he can help restore the
items.install_note: go to https://rmn.rmarchiv.de/ or https://archive.org/details/rpgmaker-net-game-archive(first site recommended) and search "Painted Heart" and download Painted Heart.exe. rename .exe to .zip and extract the gamedata. Place these extracted files into the "gamedata" folder.

items.name: Panic Room
items.description: You are a skeleton in a very small dungeon, and more traps keep appearing. You have no choice but to delay your inevitable doom by collecting as many coins as possible... or do you? How long can you last? Where are these spikes coming from? Will you ever be free?
items.install_note: Download PANIC ROOM v1.1.0.exe from https://ghostomato.itch.io/panic-room and place it in the /ports/panicroom/ folder. On first startup, the game will patch and put the files in the appropriate places.

items.name: Papers, Please
items.description: Congratulations. The October labor lottery is complete. Your name was pulled. For immediate placement, report to the Ministry of Admission at Grestin Border Checkpoint. An apartment will be provided for you and your family in East Grestin. Expect a Class-8 dwelling. Glory to Arstotzka. Content warni
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and use the Steam console to download Linux version 1.2.76 using this command: `download_depot 239030 239033 4681415496149094331`. Other versions are not compatible. Put `PapersPlease` and surrounding files/folders in `ports/papersplease/gamedata/`.

items.name: PARSEC47
items.description: PARSEC47 is a retromodern hi-speed shoot 'em up where you get to defeat retro enemies modernly. The player must destroy enemies while avoiding their projectiles and collecting green clusters of boxes for points.
items.install_note: Select the stage by a keyboard or a joystick. Press a shot key to start the game. All stages are endless and created randomly each time. The game continues until you lose all ships. Control your ship and destroy enemies. While holding a slow key, the ship becomes slow.

items.name: Passage
items.description: Passage is a five-minute experimental art game that metaphorically represents an entire human lifetime, allowing players to navigate a pixelated world while exploring themes of love, aging, and mortality. The game only lasts 5 minutes. If you don't get the point at first, please keep playing.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: PAUSED
items.description: What do ducks have to do with rabbits? Exactly, adventure and physics stuff are what you're looking for!
items.install_note: Game files are already included and ready to go.

items.name: Pekka Kana 2
items.description: Pekka Kana 2 (Pekka the Rooster 2) is a jump 'n run game made in the spirit of old classic platformers such as Super Mario, Sonic the Hedgehog, Jazz Jackrabbit, Super Frog and so on.
items.install_note: Pekka Kana 2 files are already included and ready to go.

items.name: Penguin Command
items.description: This is a clone of the classic "Missile Command" Game, but it has better graphics and music. The gameplay has only been slightly modified.
items.install_note: Ready to run! Beware that the Start of the game via R1 can take a second.

items.name: Pengu Never Left
items.description: Fish and relax as the days pass by; maybe you'll fish up something interesting? There's plenty to fish up, unlock and discover!
items.install_note: Purchase the game from itch.io (https://schwegg.itch.io/pengu-never-left). Download the Windows version and copy 'Pengu Never Left.exe' to the penguneverleft/gamedata folder.

items.name: Pentasma
items.description: Pentasma is a side-scrolling arcade shooter inspired by Williams Electronics' 1981 classic 'Defender'. Protect The terraforming Humanoids from the deadly Aliens and raid the Alien planets to keep the galaxy peaceful!
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Penumbra: Overture
items.description: Penumbra: Overture is a first person survival horror game, emphasizing on survival and problem solving instead of mindless violence and gore.
items.install_note: Copy these folders and files listed below to roms/ports/penumbra/ from your game's folder: billboards/, lights/, particles/, config/, maps/, sounds/, core/, models/, textures/, fonts/, music/, graphics/, materials.cfg, resources.cfg.

items.name: Perfect Dark
items.description: A corporation is planning a conspiracy against mankind. A single woman dares to face the threat. That woman is Joanna Dark!
items.install_note: Copy your original N64 Perfect Dark ROM to ports/perfectdark. It must be version ntsc-final/US V1.1/US Rev 1, with md5sum e03b088b6ac9e0080440efed07c1e40f. Other versions will not work. You can check the md5sum using online tools.

items.name: Permanence
items.description: Objects with solid outlines are in your line of sight, objects with dashed outlines are not. Keep things out of your line of sight to leave them the way they were. You can move forwards and backwards or rotate.
items.install_note: Ready to run. Thanks Steven Miller (https://steven-miller.itch.io) for creating this game and permitting PortMaster to distribute the files.

items.name: Attack of the PETSCII Robots (OpenMSX)
items.description: Attack of the Petscii Robots is a top-down action-puzzle game. This free version was developed by Robosoft for the MSX1. It is inspired by oblique top-down projection games like Ultima, but takes much of the gameplay concepts from first-person shooters. The object is to destroy all of the robots. To
items.install_note: Place the following BIOS files in the 'petsciirobotsmsx/share/systemroms' directory: fs-a1gt_firmware.rom, fs-a1gt_kanjifont.rom, yrw801.rom

items.name: Phasing Puller
items.description: Make your way using a Phasing Puller! By phasing through objects, this tool can pull and fasten physical objects to the bypassed item from the other side.\nDespite achieving a remarkable advance in technology, the facility now appears to be forlorn. Enveloped by a desolate atmosphere, an android set
items.install_note: Ready-To-Run!

items.name: Pigments
items.description: Be a fruit locked in a room, dodge circular saws and paint as much of the level as you can! It's a pretty addictive score-attack game with very short runs, perfect for a coffee break!
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Itch.io or Steam. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and extract the game files into gamedata folder. For Steam, download the MacOS depot via the Steam console using this command: download_depot 2339080 2339082 577923055002199486, then copy the files into gamedata folder.

items.name: Pillars of Dust
items.description: n this retro-style RPG, Prince Carlton and pauper Gregg must make their separate ways through a mysterious land to learn their origins - and find some nuggets along the way.
items.install_note: Buy and download the game from Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

items.name: Pingo
items.description: Pingo is a puzzle game in which your goal is to paint the whole level in as little steps as possible. Try to earn all 3 stars in 60 hand crafted levels!
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: Pingus
items.description: Pingus is a free clone of the popular Lemmings game. Your goal is to guide a horde of penguins through a world full of obstacles and penguin traps to safety. Although penguins (unlike lemmings) are rather smart, they sometimes lack the necessary overview and now rely on you to save them.
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Pinky
items.description: This game follows the untold journey of Pinky, the tiny slime from Terraria. Next time you slay Pinky, pause -- if only for a moment -- to reflect on the adventures, hardships, and quiet heroism that led him to that final encounter.
items.install_note: Download the Pinky.zip version for free at itch.io (https://omich.itch.io/pinky). Extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

items.name: Pip Flip Paradise
items.description: Flip the floor, roll the dice and be ready to adapt to changing situations as you find your own solution! Collect bells by flipping floor tiles and dodging hazards. Watch out, however, as flipping six tiles will re-roll them into different forms that may help or hinder your progress!
items.install_note: Ready to run!

items.name: Pippu - Bauble Quest
items.description: Take Pippu on an epic platforming adventure to defeat the nefarious Obkins and retrieve the stolen Baubles! Run, climb and swim your way through 14 worlds to bash the baddies and save your planet.
items.install_note: Purchase the full game at itch.io (https://ci.itch.io/pippu-bauble-quest). Download the Pippu (Zipped Folder) version and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

items.name: Pixel Skater Dude
items.description: A simple skateboarding game made with Gameboy spec's. Very much a prototype but playable.
items.install_note: Go to https://jmation.itch.io/pixel-skater-dude and download Pixel_Skater_Dude_v0.6.zip un-zip that and put data.win into ports/pixelskaterdude/assets

items.name: Pizza Tower
items.description: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.
items.install_note: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game data to `pizzatower/assets`.

items.name: Plague
items.description: PLAGUE is heavily inspired on Gargoyle's Quest for the original Gameboy. It's a platformer where you can control a plague doctor, throwing explosive potions and dashing mid-air.
items.install_note: Ready 2 Run

items.name: Planet Merge
items.description: Suika game with celestial bodies! Merge planets, moons, and more to create massive cosmic objects and rack up high scores.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: Plants vs Zombies Neighborhood Defense
items.description: Plants vs Zombies Neighborhood Defense is a PVZ fangame with high difficulty and new content!
items.install_note: Ready to run!

And since you’ve clearly been instructed not to touch anything, the only
items.install_note: 1. Download the latest port version. 2. Download the game from Itch.io. 3. Transfer data.win to the `pleasedonttouchanything/gamedata` folder. 4. Enjoy the game! :)

items.name: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties
items.description: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties is an adult-oriented "romantic comedy" visual novel/dating sim developed by United Pixtures and published by Kirin Entertainment for the 3DO Interactive Multiplayer. Although the game did have a Microsoft Windows version, it had very limited distribution and was published by
items.install_note: This port requires the pc version. Copy GAME.BIN and folders SC00 - SC32 and SC99 to the DATA folder

items.name: Pocket Wonder Sport
items.description: 10 totally not bootleg games in 1 cartridge file! Inspired by weird rom collections on pirate multicarts, but hopefully with a tiny bit more quality.
items.install_note: All game files are included. Thanks to Harley Wilson at https://hwilson.itch.io/pocket-wonder-sport for creating the game and allowing us to distribute.

items.name: Postal
items.description: Postal is a 1997 isometric shoot 'em up where players control the "Postal Dude" as he commits mass murder in Paradise, Arizona, progressing by killing a set percentage of armed hostiles per level.
items.install_note: 1. Download *Postal* from either GOG or Steam. 2. Locate the `res` folder and POSTAL.INI file inside your installed game directory. 3. Copy the `res` folder and the POSTAL.INI file and paste it inside the `postal/` folder in the `ports/` directory on your device.

items.name: Post Void
items.description: Post Void is a hypnotic scramble of early first-person shooter design that values speed above all else. Keep your head full and reach the end; Kill what you can to see it mend; Get the high score or try again.
items.install_note: Purchase the game from steam. Download the latest version of the game and place the all game files from /Post Void into ports/postvoid/assets

items.name: Powder

items.install_note: Powder files are already included and ready to go.

items.install_note: Download Power Level v1.2.zip from https://smithmanc.itch.io/power-level, Place Power Level v1.2.zip into /ports/powerlevel/assets.

items.name: Powermanga

items.description: PowerPutt Legend is a unique minigolf game with RPG elements, meant to look and feel like it's straight out of the NES. Slay monsters, level up, and unlock a series of items to improve your strategy.
items.install_note: Ready to run! Thanks to Team Bugulon granting us permission to distribute.

items.name: Abu Simbel Profanation Deluxe
items.description: An open-source, freeware remake of the Spanish platform game from 1985 replaces the graphics and sounds with new enhanced assets, while maintaining the same unforgiving gameplay of the original.
items.install_note: Just download and play.

items.name: Project S.H.M.O.O.P
items.description: Project S.H.M.O.O.P is a horizontal shoot-em-up (shmup) that hearkens back to shmups of the 90's. It features 5 levels, 14 bosses, 2 playable ships, and 0 original assets.
items.install_note: Download the Shmoop.rar from https://sinoc.itch.io/shmoop and extract Shmoop.exe into assets folder.

items.name: Project Starship
