items.install_note: Purchase at Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/454890/Project_Starship/ place project_starship.exe into assets folder.

items.install_note: Purchase the game at itch.io (https://cosmicvoid.itch.io/the-corruption-within), grab the Windows version (The Corruption Within Itch version.zip), extract and copy the game files into thecorruptionwithin/gamedata folder.

items.name: The Curse Of Issyos
items.description: Defkalion was fishing on a quiet blue sea when he heard the voice of the Goddess Athena. Hurry up, she said, the isle of Issyos has been cursed by the Olympus. And so, fearing for his daughter Delia, his only family left, the fisherman sails back to his home, where the adventure is about to begin.
items.install_note: Download the game from [official website](https://locomalito.com/games/the-curse-of-issyos) and extract all game files into the `assets` folder.

items.name: The Dead Prince
items.description: Play the role of a blood magic assassin fulfilling the pact his family made long ago. Use your assortment of magical abilities to sneak through bases, take down guards, and assassinate your target.
items.install_note: Demo Game is included. But once you see how fun this game is and decide to buy it, get it off STEAM from here, https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810530/The_Dead_Prince/ To use the full version: In the Steam client, right-click on the game in your library and select 'Manage', then 'Browse Local Files' and Copy the game files into the port's 'thedeadprince/assets' folder, Launching the full game for the first time may take a moment as it applies a patch, so just be patient.

items.name: The Death of Santa
items.description: Santa must gather each gift along his way across and up treacherous platforms. Watch your step! Don't let the fat guy in red become the splat guy in red!
items.install_note: Ready to Run

items.name: The Final Boss
items.description: Play as the Final Boss and crush waves of heroes invading your lair. Features 6 bosses across fantasy, space, and modern scenarios in an '80s-style arcade tribute with unlockable Endless Mode.
items.install_note: Purchase the game at itch.io (https://carloc.itch.io/the-final-boss) or Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049670/The_Final_Boss). Download, extract, and copy the game files to the thefinalboss/gamedata folder.

items.name: The Flayed Man
items.description: You are the Flayed Man. Awaking in a decayed, otherworldly house where your every waking moment is agony, you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this unsettling, macabre adventure.
items.install_note: Purchase the game on itch.io (https://snoringdoggames.itch.io/the-flayed-man) or Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471670/The_Flayed_Man). Copy the 'The Flayed Man.ags' file to the 'theflayedman/gamedata' folder.

items.name: Star Wars: Dark Forces
items.description: LucasArts 1995 FPS starring Kyle Katarn. Runs on The Force Engine (native Jedi Engine reimplementation) for ARM handhelds and x86_64 Linux. Requires original game files from GOG or Steam.
items.install_note: Copy Dark Forces files to theforceengine/game/ (must include DARK.GOB). GOG and Steam installs work if you copy the game folder contents as-is.

items.name: The Hermetic Tower
items.description: A dark fantasy visual novel. Climb a sealed tower floor by floor through branching dialogue, exploration and real-time battles, toward one of four endings.
items.install_note: Ready to run, no additional files needed.

items.name: The Impossible Game
items.description: The Impossible Game is a brutally challenging rhythm-based platformer where you control a square navigating a course of obstacles. items.install_note: Copy the Linux game files from Steam to the ports/theimpossiblegame/gamedata directory. To get the Linux files from Steam, open the Steam console steam://open/console and run: download_depot 251630 251632, then copy the contents of the downloaded depot into ports/theimpossiblegame/gamedata/.

items.name: The Last Summer: Prologue
items.description: The first three chapters of a cozy isometric story game about a seaside hotel closed for twenty years. Free, in eight languages; the world zooms in on small handheld screens.
items.install_note: Ready to run. The first start unpacks the game data, which takes a moment. Language, Zoom and Text size are in Settings.

items.name: Thermomorph
items.description: An Alien-inspired survive-the-night horror game, created in Love2D. Your crew is dead. Unidentified creatures stalk the halls of your mining ship. Armed with a motion sensor and a flamethrower, you must survive until the escape pod is repaired.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: The Rush
items.description: The Rush is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up with graphics inspired by classic space shooters of the MSX. Buckle up and see if you have what it takes to master the highly adaptive Chameleon Quartz space fighter and single-handedly obliterate the alien invaders!
items.install_note: Ready to Run!

items.name: The Saloon
items.description: Another reverse-sheepherder game. Rolling rolls your gun; rolling reloads your gun.
items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: The Sphinx of Time
items.description: Time slowed down -- a little at first, and no one noticed. Then the leaves began to stall in the sky. items.install_note: Ready to run.

items.name: The Starlit Escape
items.description: The Starlit Escape! A Game Boy style Metroidvania about exploring a haunted space station and meeting ghosts along the way! Made in the month of October for Halloween
items.install_note: Ready to Run!

items.name: The Sun and Moon
items.description: The Sun and Moon, the winner of Ludum Dare 29, is a platformer with a unique mechanic: you can dive into the ground. items.install_note: Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/321560/The_Sun_and_Moon/ Download and install the game and place The Sun and Moon.exe into ports/thesunandmoon/ On first startup, the game will patch and put the files in the appropriate places.

items.name: The Swapper
items.description: A puzzle-platformer set aboard an abandoned space station, built around creating and swapping between clones.
items.install_note: Purchase The Swapper on Steam, download the Windows depot with `download_depot 231160 231161 5334393392610826601`, and copy its files into `ports/theswapper/gamedata`.

items.name: The Wind

items.install_note: Download THEWIND_v1-0.zip free on itch.io (https://airdorf.itch.io/thewind), extract it, and copy THEWIND_v1-0.exe to the port's gamedata folder.

items.install_note: Download assets from https://github.com/TheXTech/TheXTech/releases, file thextech-smbx13-assets-full.7z, unpack it to ./thextech/assets/smbx. Check README for more details!

items.name: Thunder Punch

items.install_note: Install port. Then download Thunder Punch.zip file from Itch.io, extract it and place files into the ports/thunderpunch/assets folder.

items.description: Thy Sword is a hack n' slash platformer with procedural levels and roguelike elements.

items.name: TINAMP

items.install_note: Install the application and place your audio books inside the existing ports application audiobooks folder. For more folder options see notes section.

items.description: Tiny Crate is a cute little precision platformer with puzzle elements! Lift and toss crates to traverse over spike pits and reach higher ground! Push yourself and make tight jumps! You got this!
